items.description: verify lastCookTime() units with a known cook
items.detail: ui_available=False (headless): DECLARED DELTA (H22.0.400): lastCookTime()==0.0 for a real cook (wall_seconds=0.099009, cookCount 0->1) matches the original M3 finding recorded at commit ede8d1b8 (git history -- NOT this same artifact file, which this run overwrites; see the FAIL branch above for what a genuine contract change reports) -- EXPECTED, not a failure. Units evidence for the positive-value (GUI) path (milliseconds) lives in harness/notes/cache_h22_gui_assay_22.0.400.json (a headless run cannot self-prove units when the reading is unconditionally 0.0). Confirmed host/cache_host_probe.py's _evidence_last_cook_seconds classifies this exact reading as UNKNOWN with the 'lastCookTime_unreported' warning: last_cook_seconds={'value': None, 'unit': 'seconds', 'source': 'unknown', 'observed_at': '2026-08-09T19:29:13.789343+00:00', 'scope': 'node:/obj/cache_h22_assay/UNIT_CHECK_HEAVY', 'confidence': 'unknown'}, warnings=['lastCookTime_unreported: lastCookTime() resolved to 0.0 despite cookCount()=1 (>0) -- indistinguishable from an unreported cook time (see harness/notes/cache_h22_contract_assay_22.0.400.json item 3 for the observed headless case). "Resolved to", not "returned": this covers both a real non-positive return AND a lastCookTime() exception that safe_call already degraded to None -- a real exception is recorded as its own, separate warning entry in this same list, never folded into this one. Treating as UNKNOWN, never fabricating a measured 0.0-second cook.']. "This exact reading" is earned, not assumed: independent re-reads immediately before/after the probe call were both pre_probe_reread=0.0/post_probe_reread=0.0 (both 0.0) and the probe's own warnings carried no lastCookTime exception (no_exception_warning=True).
